## v1.10 — Trajectories, Editable Settings & Internal Overhaul

### New Features
- **Trajectories module (Render).** Predicts and draws the flight path of shootable/throwable
  items, integrated with the vanilla gravity/drag model and clipped against world geometry with an
  impact marker.
  - **Your own** arc for the item you're holding/drawing (bow draw-strength aware, crossbow,
    trident, snowball, egg, ender pearl, splash/lingering potion, experience bottle) — drawn cyan.
  - **Enemy** arcs (red) for any player/mob within ~64 blocks that is actively drawing a bow,
    charging a trident, or holding a loaded crossbow — so you can see incoming shots and where
    they'll land.
  - Toggle each independently with the `Self` and `Others` settings.
- **Editable settings in the ClickGUI.** Expand a module (right-click) and click its settings:
  left-click increases / toggles / picks the next option, right-click goes back. Numbers are
  bounded and stepped, toggles flip, multiple-choice settings cycle.
- **Settings now persist.** Every setting value is saved to `config/claudemc/modules.json` and
  restored on the next launch. (Module enabled-state is intentionally not auto-restored.)

### Internal / Architecture
- **Typed setting system** (`BoolSetting` / `NumberSetting` / `ModeSetting` / `StringSetting`)
  replacing the old stringly-typed pairs, with backward-compatible inference so existing modules
  became editable automatically. ESP/Tracers/Nuker mode & range settings are now first-class.
- **Shared `BlockScanModule`** engine extracted from BlockESP/StorageESP (throttled tick scan →
  cached snapshot → render), removing the duplicated per-frame-scan code.
- **Mixin hardening:** the Timer multiplier can no longer be driven to 0 (which would freeze
  ticking); the Vanish packet-reflection now logs once on failure instead of silently disabling.
- **Unit tests** added for the setting types and `ServerInfo`, plus a **Build & Test CI** workflow
  that compiles and runs them on every push/PR.
- **Developer docs:** `ARCHITECTURE.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

### Docs
- README updated to v1.10 (correct JAR names, live settings-editing guide, Trajectories section,
  refreshed BlockESP custom-blocks instructions, corrected RecordProof implementation note).
